block-core-cup-mps59a.summary: This separate shallow cup is the single MPS-59A block closure listed in the applicable MPE-107R replacement kit. Its host opening has not been located.
block-core-cup-mps59a.limits: Uninstalled inch-column envelope. Catalog2.070in gives52.578mm but its metric column says52.48mm; discrepancy remains. Uniform1mm wall and corners are estimated; bore, interference and location unknown.

steps.title: Read the free envelope
steps.text: The catalog gives free OD2.065–2.075in and height.343in. Candidate OD52.578mm is an explicit selection within that range, not a measured installed diameter.

steps.title: Separate cup construction from size
steps.text: The wall parameter changes the hollow section while preserving OD and height. Actual sheet thickness, drawn radii and seating depth need evidence.

steps.title: Identify the correct host
steps.text: One kit cup does not identify one engine bore. Verify casting opening, bore size and specified fit before assigning an occurrence.

troubleshooting.title: Do not diagnose from an isolated model
troubleshooting.text: The uninstalled cup has no pressure, corrosion or leakage simulation. A nearby leak requires inspection of the actual closure and fluid path.

block-pipe-plug-mpp554.summary: Two MPP-554 threaded closures are listed in the applicable replacement kit. They close threaded openings, but their engine locations and exact thread definition are unresolved.
block-pipe-plug-mpp554.limits: No CAD or installed occurrence. Nominal3/8pipe size is not actual OD. The manufacturer table lacks a part-specific thread standard, taper and pitch, so NPT or NPTF must not be assumed.

steps.title: Distinguish pipe size from measured diameter
steps.text: The row supplies nominal3/8 size,9.525mm length and5/16in key. Those dimensions do not fully define the outside threaded surface.

steps.title: Establish the thread and host together
steps.text: A part-specific thread drawing and identified mating gallery port are required before modeling engagement, sealing or installed depth.

troubleshooting.title: Avoid plausible but mismatched threads
troubleshooting.text: A generic plug with the same nominal label may use a different thread/sealing form. This evidence row is not a fit recommendation or installation instruction.
